notes.text: The beginning of the chapter names Naftali and Mana in the exception for a priest whose appearance is familiar in his own town.
The exact parallel repeats the question and uses עקימה for the finger.

Both cited witnesses have singular finger and agree on the adjective, with עקומה in Taanit and עקימה in Megillah. The pinned Warsaw text reads מקומות. The bracket marks the contextual English reading; leave the Hebrew and collation record intact.
The separate Heilprin notice explicitly lists Yaakov and points to Yitzḥak as a possible scribal correction. This internal link does not establish Yaakov’s historical identity.
The separate Yitzḥak dossier repeats Heilprin’s failure to find Yaakov and labels the proposed scribal error as conjecture.
The Bavli explicitly names Rav Yitzḥak bar Naftali replying to Ravina, independently supporting expansion of the patronymic. Keep Heilprin’s existing title.
Printed Heilprin witness comparison is still needed to determine whether the source difficulty is inherited or digital.
